item.title: Zep Alternatives: Open-Source and Hosted Options
item.description: Zep alternatives are other ways to give AI agents long-term memory: Graphiti (Zep’s own open-source core), Hindsight, Mem0, Letta, Cognee and Supermemory. Most people searching for one want a self-hosted, open-source option, because Zep stopped maintaining its Community Edition in 2025 and is now a managed, credit-priced service. Graphiti is the closest match to Zep’s model; Hindsight is the most complete open-source memory server, with graph and time-range recall, consolidation and reflect all in its MIT release.

item.title: Zep Docker in 2026: Self-Hosting Options Explained
item.description:
You can’t self-host today’s Zep with Docker. Zep Community Edition, the Docker-based self-hosted Zep, has been deprecated since April 2025. What you can run in Docker now is Graphiti, Zep’s open-source temporal graph engine, as a REST server with Neo4j or an MCP server with FalkorDB. The full Zep product runs in your own cloud only on the Enterprise plan.

Many guides still show docker compose up for Zep. They describe an edition that gets no updates or support. This page lays out the real options as of 8 October 2026, with working Compose setups, based on the getzep/zep and Graphiti repositories.

item.title: Zep vs Mem0: Temporal Graph vs Fact Memory
item.description: Zep vs Mem0 is a choice between two ways of storing what an agent learns. Zep keeps a temporal knowledge graph where every fact has a validity window, so old facts are invalidated rather than lost. Mem0 extracts short facts into a vector store with entity linking, and ranks them by semantic, keyword and entity match. Mem0 is open source; Zep is a managed service with Graphiti as its open-source core.

item.title: What Is Zep Memory? Zep Cloud, Graphiti and Pricing
item.description:
Zep memory is Zep Cloud, a managed service that stores what an agent learns from users and data in a temporal context graph, then returns a prompt-ready block of relevant facts. Its open-source core is Graphiti, a framework for knowledge graphs that track when facts change. The old self-hosted Zep Community Edition is deprecated.

This page covers what Zep is now, how Zep memory stores and retrieves data, the Zep paper, pricing, self-hosting, and integrations. Sources are Zep’s docs, the Graphiti repo and the Zep pricing page.
